description: Mostly an early-game (opening, ply under ~10) unit with no clean concept. Strongest when the opponent has just stacked high in a centre column (column 3 at row 2+, column 4 at row 3+, e.g. 4,4,4,4). Also often fires early when columns 3 and 4 are both still empty and the last move went to columns 0-2 or 6. A stone at the bottom of column 3 or 4 suppresses it. Many exceptions.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.01 on 7 positions.
notes: 5 of 8 score calls. Best dev F1 0.284 (P 0.19, R 0.55, AUROC 0.74), sim share 0.05 (h4). Other tries: early-game-only 0.195; centre-empty 0.195; +late col-4-empty 0.219. Ply-3 act tables show irregular context dependence; layer 1; zero steering effect. Looks like a random direction or a mixture of last-move-column, ply and centre-occupancy signals. Two synthesis positions beat the dev max (1.413, 1.406).
